ns2:section.sectionText: This course examines the current literature on the microeconomics of development in low- and middle-income countries. We will cover the role of financial constraints, including credit, savings and insurance as well as issues of trade, infrastructure, migration, education, marriage and an introduction to machine learning. We will also review several recent or current-year job market papers from microeconomic development students.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Economics department.
